name: HR Prompts
intro: Templates for hiring and feedback work. AI-assisted employment decisions carry legal exposure (see the hiring discrimination cases in the AI Lawsuit Tracker); these templates draft documents for human review, they do not screen or rank people.

templates.tip: The inclusive-language pass at the end catches gendered and age-coded phrasing that first drafts often carry.
templates.title: Job description from role facts
templates.prompt: Draft a job description. Role: {TITLE}, level {LEVEL}, reporting to {MANAGER_TITLE}, {LOCATION_OR_REMOTE}. The five outcomes this person must deliver in year one: {LIST}. Required skills, keep to six or fewer: {LIST}. Salary range, include it verbatim: {RANGE}. Structure: two-sentence hook about the work itself, outcomes, requirements, nice-to-haves (three maximum), benefits, range, and an equal-opportunity statement. Then do a second pass and list any phrasing you changed for inclusive language and why.

templates.tip: Behavioral questions anchored to the actual competencies produce comparable candidates; that comparability is the legal and practical point of structure.
templates.title: Structured interview question bank
templates.prompt: Create a structured interview kit for {ROLE}. Competencies to assess: {COMPETENCY_1}, {COMPETENCY_2}, {COMPETENCY_3}, {COMPETENCY_4}. For each competency: two behavioral questions (tell me about a time...), one situational question, what a strong answer contains, what a weak answer sounds like, and a 1-to-4 scoring anchor. Add three follow-up probes usable on any question. Exclude anything touching protected characteristics, family status, health, or age. Format as a scoring sheet an interviewer can fill in.

templates.tip: The template forces specifics-plus-impact; vague feedback is what makes reviews useless and contestable.
templates.title: Performance feedback draft
templates.models: Any; review carefully, this is a human conversation, not a document problem.
templates.prompt: Draft performance feedback for a {ROLE}. Review period: {PERIOD}. Facts I am providing, use only these: accomplishments {LIST_WITH_SPECIFICS}, areas to improve {LIST_WITH_EXAMPLES}, goals agreed last cycle and their status {LIST}. Structure: overall summary in two sentences, what went well (each item: the specific, its impact), growth areas (each item: the observed behavior, its impact, the expected change), goals for next period as measurable statements. Professional, direct, no praise inflation, no speculation about motives or personal circumstances.
